lines.text:
You're wondering if it's a heavy load?
Not at all. It's only 4 tons.

I'm confident when it comes to making weapons,
but actually being in battle...

I still can't believe I'm a member of the Goddess Squad. 
I need to pull my weight.

Lilith is the best! 
She's strong, nice, cool, and... just the best!

Nothing is greater than the Goddess Squad.
It's such an honor to be a part of it.

Red Hood...
Hehe. She is a good person.
Uh... Should I keep standing here?

Don't worry about me.
I'll be here working on more weapon designs.
I'd love to take the Lift one day.

I adore snow-covered mountains.
I'm not even sure why, but I just do.

There's no place in particular that I want to go.
The important thing is that you're there with me.

I'm Snow White. 
I'm in charge of weapons development and maintenance.
Output increase confirmed.
At this rate, am I closing in on Lilith?

I like getting stronger.
It means I can better help those around me.
Wow, thank you! Really.

Is... 
Is it really okay if I accept this?
Thank you! I'll be sure to put it to good use.
I'll be sure to work even harder going forward.
I will act in a manner befitting the Goddess Squad.
Is there any weapon in particular that you want? I could make it for you.
Snow White. Engaging.
Snow White, present.
Proceeding to target.
Encounter!
Uh... I'm anxious.
E-enemy spotted!
Stay alive, everyone!
Re-reloading!
Hu-hurry!
Like this.
Seven Dwarves, ready!
I'll take it from here.
Everyone focus your fire!
There we go!
Did we get them?
Excellent.
Ugh!
Argh!
Lilith!
I'm sorry... I'll get out of everyone's hair.
The Goddess Squad is victorious once again!
